body:
Source: GitHub issues #794 (bug, P1-high, false-green) and #795 (bug, P1-high, undeclared breaking change), both in packages/tickets/lib/doctor.mjs `manifestForestCheck` (:324-368). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a. (a) :329 `const { valid } = discoverSegments(dir);` drops `invalid` on the floor, so a planted symlink, nested directory, non-regular file, bad-grammar name or fake `*.lock` under `.adlc/manifest.d/` — every one of which `forestChainsIntact` fails closed on (`if (invalid.length > 0) return false`) and every evidence-required writer rejects with INVALID_MANIFEST — produces `manifest-forest: { ok: true }`. Repro: in a segmented scratch repo create `.adlc/manifest.d/evil-dir/` and a symlink `.adlc/manifest.d/aaa-01ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ22.jsonl -> /etc/passwd`; `adlc ticket doctor --json` reports ok:true with segments:1. (b) :352 `if (!valid.includes(token.segment))` flags the `.lineage` token stale with no regard for `token.branch`. `.lineage` is gitignored and survives `git checkout`; segment files are committed and do not. After `git checkout main` from an unmerged feature branch the token names a segment this checkout does not have → `staleLineage` set, ok:false, and `@adlc/ticket-sync`'s composed doctor exits 2 on a healthy repo. Every resolver already applies a branch predicate: `peekOpenSegment` (packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs:262-265) only considers the token when `branch !== null && token.branch === branch`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/tickets` (an npm workspace): lib/doctor.mjs (manifestForestCheck, doctorTicketStore), lib/manifest-primitives.mjs (`discoverSegments(dir)` → `{ valid: string[], invalid: {name, reason}[] }` at :133; `currentBranch(cwd)` at :230 returns the branch name or null on detached HEAD/error; `readLineageToken(dir)` at :243 returns `{ segment, ulid, branch }` or null; `ulidOf`, `isSegmentedRepo`, `segmentPath`). Tests: `npm test -w packages/tickets`; existing forest cases live in test/doctor.test.mjs:624-730 (`forestCheck(report)` helper, a segmented-fixture builder — copy its fixture shape into the new file rather than editing it). Consumer: packages/ticket-sync/lib/doctor.mjs:46 composes `doctorTicketStore(store, { root, archive: true, key })` and maps ok:false to exit 2 — run `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/doctor.test.mjs` (read-only consumer check; ticket-sync is a producer-tier package and is NOT edited here).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. ONE exported pure function in lib/doctor.mjs, `classifyLineageToken(token, branch, validSegments)`, returns exactly one of: `{ kind: 'none' }` (no token), `{ kind: 'foreign', segment, ulid, branch: token.branch }` (token.branch !== branch, INCLUDING when `branch` is null — detached HEAD — matching peekOpenSegment's fall-through), `{ kind: 'stale', segment, ulid, reason }` (same branch, segment absent or ULID mismatch, the two existing reason strings verbatim), or `{ kind: 'ok', segment, ulid }`. It never touches the filesystem.
2. `manifestForestCheck` destructures `{ valid, invalid }`; the result gains `invalidSegments: invalid` (the array exactly as discoverSegments returns it) and `ok` is `orphanedAnchors.length === 0 && staleLineage === null && invalid.length === 0`.
3. `manifestForestCheck` calls `classifyLineageToken(readLineageToken(dir), currentBranch(root), valid)`: `stale` populates `staleLineage` (same shape as today); `foreign` leaves `staleLineage: null` and sets a new informational field `foreignLineage: { segment, ulid, branch }` that does NOT affect `ok`; `ok`/`none` leave both null. `foreignLineage` is `null` when absent so the result shape is stable.
4. Regression guards: a healthy forest still reports ok with `invalidSegments: []`, `foreignLineage: null`; an un-segmented repo is still `{ ok: true, segmented: false }`; orphaned-anchor detection unchanged; a same-branch stale token still fails exactly as today; `doctorTicketStore`'s other checks untouched.
5. Documentation: `packages/tickets/README.md` (near the `adlc ticket doctor --json` line ~24) and by hand `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/tickets.mdx` gain two sentences: the manifest-forest check reports non-conforming objects under manifest.d as `invalidSegments` and fails on them, and a `.lineage` token left by another branch is reported as `foreignLineage` without failing the check. Never regenerate the mdx.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A segmented fixture with a nested directory and a symlink under `.adlc/manifest.d/` → check `ok: false`, `invalidSegments` lists both with discoverSegments' reasons. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor-forest-invalid-lineage.test.mjs`
- AC2 A `.lineage` whose `branch` differs from the fixture repo's current branch and names a segment not present → `ok: true`, `staleLineage: null`, `foreignLineage` names the token's segment, ulid and branch. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor-forest-invalid-lineage.test.mjs`
- AC3 A `.lineage` on the SAME branch naming an absent segment → `ok: false` with the existing `staleLineage` reason (regression); same branch with a ULID mismatch → the existing ULID reason. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor-forest-invalid-lineage.test.mjs`
- AC4 `classifyLineageToken` table: null token → none; branch null → foreign; differing branch → foreign; same branch + present segment + matching ulid → ok; same branch + absent → stale; same branch + ulid mismatch → stale; the token object is not mutated. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor-forest-invalid-lineage.test.mjs`
- AC5 Through the CLI: `adlc ticket doctor --json` (drive bin via node) on the AC1 fixture exits non-zero and the JSON shows `invalidSegments`; on the AC2 fixture exits 0. verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/doctor-forest-invalid-lineage.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green and untouched. verify: `npm test -w packages/tickets`
- AC7 ticket-sync's composed doctor still green. verify: `node --test packages/ticket-sync/test/doctor.test.mjs`
- AC8 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "foreignLineage" packages/tickets/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/tickets.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: surfacing a malformed segment FIRST LINE (readChain's leniency — separate design), packages/ticket-sync (producer tier; consumer test only), lib/manifest-primitives.mjs, any writer path, #896 (keyless discard), #892 (loader error pointers).
title: tickets: doctor manifest-forest reports invalid segments and ignores another branch's .lineage token
